summary: The registered three-file design specification is unchanged from this reviewer's completed independent inspection. All three current file hashes match the linked contract. The specification provides an implementable additive Figma projection for the 475-token foundation and 32 component families across A/B/C, with explicit modes, alias direction, typography representation, supported bindings, meaningful states and structural readbacks. Existing architecture, permission and effect semantics remain preserved.
evidence_limits: Static specification approval only. Figma mutation remains held until preview completion. Actual structural and rendered validation is required.
